label: prop:mass-categorical-descent
title: QOU mass formula as descent decomposition of the mass endomorphism
html:
The mass identity decomposes under the descent involution into a descended component and a transient component:

  B(Z,N) = B^{\mathrm{desc}}(Z,N) + B^{\mathrm{trans}}(Z,N).

The descended component resides in the center of the Hecke algebra. The transient component localizes to the exceptional divisors of the brane blow-up.

Descended terms. The descended elements are Casimir operators corresponding to the volume, pairing, and Wigner terms of the liquid-drop model. They evaluate purely via quantum factorials scaled by Plancherel weights.

Transient terms. The transient elements isolate corrections from the surface boundary, the Coulomb charge locus, the exchange parity locus, and magic-number shell closures. Each corresponds to a specific geometric blow-up evaluated by a quantum dilogarithm correction based on its Schur-Weyl magnetic quantum number. The descent decomposition structures both the mass endomorphism and the electromagnetic coupling.
